test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Under the Chief Minister Learn and Earn Scheme of Madhya Pradesh, the government will NOT provide which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is **Laptops**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Financial assistance** is provided to support students in their learning journey.
 
• **Training** is offered to equip students with the necessary skills.
 
• **Employable skills** are imparted to ensure that students are job-ready.
 
• The government does not provide **laptops** under this scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Chief Minister Learn and Earn Scheme** is an initiative by the Madhya Pradesh government aimed at providing youth with the skills and financial support necessary for employment.

 
 

 Component
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Financial Assistance**
 Monetary support to aid students in their education and skill development.
 
 

 **Training**
 Programs aimed at enhancing the skills of students to make them job-ready.
 
 

 **Employable Skills**
 Focus on skills that are in demand in the job market to ensure better employment opportunities.
 
 

 **Government Initiative**
 A state government program specifically designed to support the youth of Madhya Pradesh.
